docker_commands: docker network inspect my-network >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create my-network
cd /efs/fims/replace_and_route/docker && pwd && docker build -t pg_db -f Dockerfile.db .
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter 'ancestor=pg_db:latest') && [ -n "$CID" ] && docker rm -f $CID || echo 'No container to remove'

cd /efs/fims/replace_and_route/data/rfc_channel_forcings && sudo rm -rf *.csv && cd /efs/fims/replace_and_route/ && docker run --rm --name rnr -v /efs/fims/replace_and_route/data:/data -v /efs/fims/replace_and_route/logs:/logs --network my-network rnr:latest
